lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Keep your head down, kid.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Clean floors, clear words.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Excuse me...

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Are you the one they call 'The Ghost' in the notes?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I’m from The Paragon.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Keep your voice down, kid.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: I told Enzo I’d only speak once.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: That office is a hornet's nest right now.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: The director is threatening to shut us down because the file looks like a mess.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I have the raw text here, but it's just a wall of words.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I need to know—did you really see them moving the gasoline?

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: I saw it.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Late at night, behind the gym.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: They were using the school budget for 'maintenance,' but that fuel wasn't for the mowers.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: It was for their personal cars.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: That’s exactly what the transcript says, but it’s so hard to read.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: If I format this properly—make the questions and answers clear—will you stand by it?

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: If you make it readable, the truth speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Just don't put my real name on it yet.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Now go.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: If Reyes sees us talking, I’m the next one out the door.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I’ll make sure every word is clear.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: No more 'gibberish.'

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Make sure that story is formatted clean.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: The truth needs to speak for itself.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Keep your head down, kid.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Clean floors, clear words.
